detail.title: Operational Frameworks for Autonomous Research
detail.summary: This revision updates the analysis of question generation, clarifying that existing methods prioritize factoid retrieval over open-ended scientific inquiry, which poses a significant hurdle for autonomous research agents.
detail.reason: Updating notebook findings to reflect specific evidence on current question generation limitations.

detail.title: Operational Frameworks for Autonomous Research
detail.summary: This revision synthesizes findings on existing factoid-based research question models with emerging insights from inquiry-based learning structures to broaden the scope of autonomous research formulation.
detail.reason: Integrating newly collected evidence on inquiry-based learning into the existing framework for autonomous question generation.
